streets.name: Calle de Picasso
streets.trust: 25 Nov 2026 (Dave: this is Calle Picasso): the footpath along the main car park's west side, behind the hedge strip at the back of the west bays, from the CALLE DE PICASSO plinth and lantern where it meets the Juan Gris paving (IMG_3131) to the end of Calle Eva. The Esri aerial, straightened along the west bay row, shows a pale tiled band 8.4 m west of the bays' car line (brightness and colour profiles every 3 m, straight to 0.45 m rms), about 1.5-2 m wide, between the house garden walls and the green hedge strip; Google's standard map labels this line C. Pintor Picasso (reference/google-maps/01). Width 1.8 m estimated. Its last 9 m to Calle Eva follow the old map line. Levels from the laser survey: three level stretches (+1.17, +0.71 and +0.20 m) joined by two flights of steps beside a ramp (data/picasso_path_steps.json). Not photographed between the plinth and Calle Eva. Earlier this id was a 4 m asphalt 'car-park access' line from Google's map, about 2 m east of the path.
